summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; client_id from login then extra.client_id; client_secret from password then extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var references for both secrets, with profile args applied before the fixed auth and secret entries). Registered it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings and in both __all__ lists, and updated the databricks package __init__. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output and env vars, and profile-arg override protection. Tests were not run, per instructions, and nothing was committed.
